texto.titulo: Weekend plans / Planos de fim de semana
texto.ru: Tomorrow the weather is going to be great. It is going to be sunny and warm, about twenty-five degrees. We are going to have a picnic in the park. My brother is going to bring the sandwiches and I am going to make a salad. My friends are going to play volleyball. On Sunday it is going to rain, so we are going to stay at home and watch films. Winter is coming, and it is going to be cold soon.
texto.pt: Amanhã o tempo vai estar ótimo. Vai fazer sol e calor, uns vinte e cinco graus. Vamos fazer um piquenique no parque. Meu irmão vai trazer os sanduíches e eu vou fazer uma salada. Meus amigos vão jogar vôlei. No domingo vai chover, então vamos ficar em casa vendo filmes. O inverno está chegando e logo vai fazer frio.

perguntas.pergunta: What is the weather going to be like tomorrow?
What is the brother going to bring?
What are they going to do on Sunday?
perguntas.resposta: Stay at home and watch films.
